summary.text: David Martsolf is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 17, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he has more than 33 years of managerial experience at Allegro MicroSystems.

paragraphs.text: David Martsolf was born in Manhattan, Kansas, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of New Hampshire in 1985.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he held managerial positions at Allegro MicroSystems as process manager, planning manager and quality manager, and that he was running in Windham.
Ballotpedia's campaign-finance listing records Martsolf as having lost the 2024 general election for New Hampshire House of Representatives Rockingham 17.
He described his campaign promise in that survey as "Fiscal Responsibility with Social Respect."
